An '''ambassador''' to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|provisional government]] served during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactici Civil War]]. The [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] met with the [[Gaddrian ambassador]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Silver Star]]'' to discuss establishing a fifth column movement inside the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] with the goal of removing [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] from power.<ref name="Luxury" />
